title: ntn.config Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response describing the configuration and identity of the paired Starnote or integrated satellite modem. Fields the module has not reported are omitted.

device.description: The identity the satellite module uses on its network, prefixed with the network's scheme (for example `skylo:` followed by the module's IMSI).

mtu.description: The maximum packet size, in bytes, the module can send or receive. Superseded by `up_mtu` and `down_mtu` when those are reported.

up_mtu.description: The maximum size, in bytes, of a packet the module can send to the satellite network.

down_mtu.description: The maximum size, in bytes, of a packet the module can receive from the satellite network.

modem.description: The model and firmware revision of the satellite modem.

policy.description: The transmission policy the module operates under, which governs how often it may send. For example, `10TPM` allows ten transmissions per minute.

sku.description: The SKU of the satellite module.

ordering_code.description: The ordering code of the satellite module.

apn.description: The access point name (APN) the module uses on the satellite network.

band.description: The radio band the module is configured to use. `0` means the network default.

channel.description: The radio channel the module is configured to use. `0` means the network default.

org.description: The organization that built the module's firmware.

product.description: The product name of the module's firmware.

target.description: The hardware target the module's firmware was built for.

version.description: The version of the firmware the module is currently running.

ver_major.description: The major version number of the module's firmware.

ver_minor.description: The minor version number of the module's firmware.

ver_patch.description: The patch version number of the module's firmware.

ver_build.description: The build number of the module's firmware.

built.description: The date and time the module's firmware was built.

err.description: This member is present if an error occurred, for example when no satellite module is connected: `{"err":"no NTN module is connected {no-ntn-module}"}`
